prompt: Use image 1 as the authority for the room, the long table, the children's look and the render style, and re-compose it as a high wide establishing shot: the camera stands at the near end of the long table, a little above head height, looking down the table toward the bright far doorway; the near end of the table and an empty first window-side chair are visible at the lower left. Stage the start of the morning. On the window side of the table, counting from the camera end, seat 1 is an empty chair, seat 2 is Maria sitting upright with a rolled-up white paper drawing held upright in her lap in both hands, looking down at it, seat 3 is the crayon boy drawing on his own sheet with a green crayon, and seats 4 and 5 are the braids girl and the jersey boy, drawing. Every other chair is empty. On the open floor to the right of the table, in front of the tiled counter, MACA stands upright with her arms down, watching Maria; her pink chest plate is bare except for its small dark inset screen, which glows softly; Chico sits on the floor at MACA's feet. The other children's sheets show families of people only: moms with brown hair, dads with big shoes, a grandma with a purple purse; the crayon boy's own sheet shows green dinosaurs; Maria's drawing is the only robot anywhere. Exactly four children, MACA and Chico; nobody else. Image 3 shows only who sits where, Maria in the nearest window-side seat and the crayon boy beyond her: ignore its drawing, its glow, its crayon marks and its framing. Image 1 is the authority for render style, lens, lighting, room, furniture and colour: keep its finished 3D animated film look exactly, as if this were another frame of the same shot. Image 2 is a painted character sheet used only for identity (faces, hair, wardrobe colours); never copy its painted style, its plain background or its poses. Identity, from image 2: Maria is a small girl with black bangs, a thin yellow headband, a side ponytail with a pink scrunchie, a pink overall outfit over a light-blue collared shirt and purple boots. The crayon boy has tousled ginger-blond hair and a green T-shirt with a small dinosaur. The braids girl has two dark braids and olive overalls over a cream shirt. The jersey boy has short brown hair and a white shirt with navy trim. MACA is a tall robot with a white riveted helmet, a glowing blue face screen with two smiling eyes, a pink chest plate with a small dark inset screen and an orange hip plate. Chico is a small tan-and-white chihuahua with a pink collar. One instance of each character only. Output one 16:9 full-colour production frame, 1280x720, no text, no sketch lines.
